crossRefs.note: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to…
Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
